note: Adapted from the species-level description of Emerson (1928), originally in English; only the soldier is given with characters and measurements, and neither the worker nor the alate is described for this species; the measurement table in the original is set in two columns, so after OCR the labels and values correspond in sequence, and they are restored here in that order; synonymy, figure numbers, localities and nesting records are not translated.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head deep reddish brown; the nasus not paler than the vertex or the region around the antennal bases, but slightly paler than the base of the nasus; the line from the tip of the nasus to the vertex slightly concave; antennae 13-segmented, segment 3 longer than segment 2, segment 2 longer than segment 4; mandibles with distinct points; nasus medium-sized, rather stout; anterior margin of the pronotum very shallowly notched. Measurements (mm): head length 1.67–1.78, head width 0.95–0.97, antennal length 1.55, pronotal length 0.17, width 0.47–0.48, hind tibia length 1.10–1.13. The syntype head is slightly wider (0.97–1.00 mm), the remaining characters very similar.
